notes.title: Time Tenshi 2: Special Edition DLC is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/560990/

Hi everyone,

We're excited to announce that Time Tenshi 2: Special Edition DLC is now available on Steam!

[b]New features include:[/b]

[list][*]Many new romance-driven choices and multiple routes to unlock, with a secret romance finale that depends on your decisions!
[*]Exciting, well-written and in-depth new scenarios with plenty of suspense and ecchi!
[*]Lots of new, quality character art, illustrations and backgrounds, all drawn by professionals!
[*]Plenty of ecchi fanservice moments throughout![/list]

[i](Please note: You must have the original version of Time Tenshi 2 on Steam in order to purchase and use this DLC. You will need to start a new save file.)[/i]

Thanks, and enjoy!

- Silver Cow Studio
